meta.ctaTitle: Run your whole store from one place
meta.ctaSub: Start free — no credit card. Upgrade as you grow.

seo.title: Order, inventory & product management — Torta CRM
seo.description: Manage products, orders, customers, inventory and bookings in one place — multi-warehouse stock, batches, low-stock alerts and live analytics. No spreadsheets.

hero.title: Every order, customer and product — structured and yours
hero.lead: Your store runs on a clean, relational database. Products, orders, customers, carts, reviews, bookings and stock all live as connected records you can read, filter and act on — no spreadsheets, no guesswork.

stats.label: Your data is fully isolated from every other store
Orders link to customers, items, payments and returns
Products, orders, customers, bookings, reviews and more
Revenue, funnel and inventory read straight from your data

cards.title: Products
cards.desc: Multi-option products with variations, sizes, per-item pricing and stock.

cards.title: Orders
cards.desc: Every order with its items, totals, payment and delivery — start to finish.

cards.title: Customers
cards.desc: A profile per buyer: contact details, order history and saved addresses.

cards.title: Reviews
cards.desc: Ratings, written reviews and photos tied to the right product.

cards.title: Bookings
cards.desc: Time-based appointments with services, staff and status.

cards.title: Analytics
cards.desc: Revenue, average order value, conversion and inventory, computed live.

deep.title: Records that already know how your store works
deep.body: You never design tables or write queries. Every part of the catalog and every sale is modeled for you, kept consistent, and ready to view, filter and act on from your dashboard.
points: Each store's data is isolated — one store never sees another's
Inventory tracked per warehouse, with batches and low-stock signals
Returns and refunds recorded against the original order
Everything visible in the dashboard — search, filter and drill in

seo.title: Customer login & accounts for your store — Torta CRM
seo.description: Let shoppers sign in with a one-time email or SMS code, or 17 social logins like Google and Apple. Guest checkout, multi-device sessions and password reset, built in.

hero.title: Sign-in your customers actually trust
hero.lead: Let shoppers create an account and log in the way they prefer — a one-time email code, their phone number, or a social account — without you building any of it.

stats.label: Google, Apple and 15 more social logins
One-time codes by email or text message
Customers see and revoke their own sessions
Buy first, create the account later

cards.title: Email code
cards.desc: Passwordless one-time codes sent to the customer's inbox.

cards.title: Phone code
cards.desc: SMS one-time codes for phone-first audiences.

cards.title: Social login
cards.desc: Google, Apple, GitHub, Discord and more in one tap.

cards.title: Password reset
cards.desc: A secure, self-serve reset flow out of the box.

cards.title: Sessions
cards.desc: Active devices listed; sign out anywhere, anytime.

cards.title: Guest checkout
cards.desc: Shoppers buy as a guest and upgrade to an account later.

deep.title: All the hard parts are handled for you
deep.body: Tokens, refresh, multi-device sessions and provider callbacks are managed behind the scenes. You switch on the methods you want; your customers just sign in.
points: One-time codes with a short expiry — no passwords to leak
Sessions refresh silently and can be revoked per device
Turn each provider on or off per store
One customer identity can work across all your store's locations

seo.title: Sell digital downloads & host product media — Torta CRM
seo.description: Upload product photos and sell digital downloads — ZIPs, audio, video, e-books, almost any file. Secure direct uploads, per-plan storage and live usage tracking.

hero.title: Store the images and files your store needs
hero.lead: Upload product photos, review images, and the digital files you sell — almost any file type — straight from the dashboard. Files upload directly and securely, and every store's media stays its own.

stats.label: Media allowance scales with your plan
Images, PDFs and the digital downloads you sell
Files go straight to storage from the browser
Your media is isolated from every other store

cards.title: Product images
cards.desc: Photo galleries per product and per variation.

cards.title: Review photos
cards.desc: Customers attach up to five photos per review.

cards.title: Avatars
cards.desc: Profile pictures for your customers.

cards.title: Email media
cards.desc: Images and PDFs you drop into email campaigns.

cards.title: Digital downloads
cards.desc: Sell digital products — ZIPs, audio, video, e-books, almost any file.

cards.title: Usage tracking
cards.desc: See exactly how much of your allowance you've used.

deep.title: Upload once, use it anywhere
deep.body: Drop a file in and get a link back right away. Storage is metered per plan so you always know where you stand, and each store's files are kept separate.
points: Upload directly from the browser — nothing to set up
Images optimized for fast loading on your storefront
Live usage shown against your plan's allowance
Deleting a store cleanly removes its files

seo.title: Webhooks, integrations & automation — Torta CRM
seo.description: Send store events — paid orders, new customers, bookings — to Slack, Discord, your own endpoint or 12 connectors. Scheduled alerts and email campaigns that run on their own.

hero.title: Connect your store to everything else you run
hero.lead: When something happens in your store — a paid order, a new customer, a cancelled booking — send it anywhere: Slack, Discord, your own endpoint, or ready-made connectors. Plus alerts and campaigns that run on a schedule.

stats.label: Orders, bookings, customers, payments and products
Slack, Discord, accounting and analytics tools
Alerts and email campaigns that fire on their own
Every send recorded with its status and retries

cards.title: Event webhooks
cards.desc: POST a JSON payload to your endpoint when an event fires.

cards.title: Slack & Discord
cards.desc: Drop order and booking updates into a channel.

cards.title: Connectors
cards.desc: Ready-made links to accounting and analytics tools.

cards.title: Scheduled alerts
cards.desc: Revenue drops, low stock and daily summaries by email.

cards.title: Email campaigns
cards.desc: One-time or recurring sends that run automatically.

cards.title: Delivery logs
cards.desc: See every delivery, its response and automatic retries.

deep.title: Pick an event, choose where it goes
deep.body: Subscribe to the events you care about and route them to the tools your team already uses. Failed deliveries retry on their own, and every attempt is logged.
points: Fourteen event types across orders, bookings, customers and products
Send to a custom endpoint, Slack or Discord
Automatic retries on failure, with a full delivery log
Scheduled alerts and campaigns run without you lifting a finger

seo.title: Email marketing & transactional email — Torta CRM
seo.description: Send order confirmations, reminders and marketing campaigns from your own verified domain (DKIM, SPF, DMARC). Built-in templates, an HTML editor and scheduling.

hero.title: Email your customers actually receive
hero.lead: Send order confirmations, reminders and marketing campaigns from your own verified domain — written in plain HTML, delivered straight from our mail servers, and tuned to land in the inbox.

stats.label: Send as you@yourbrand.com, fully verified
Messages typically arrive within a few seconds
Built-in transactional emails, all editable
One-time or recurring broadcasts to your customers

cards.title: Transactional
cards.desc: Verification, reset, order, booking, cart and restock emails.

cards.title: Campaigns
cards.desc: Broadcast announcements and promos to your customers.

cards.title: Your domain
cards.desc: Verified sending with DKIM, SPF and DMARC.

cards.title: HTML editor
cards.desc: Write the exact email you want, with a live preview.

cards.title: Scheduling
cards.desc: Send now, at a set time, or on a weekly or yearly repeat.

cards.title: Deliverability
cards.desc: Authenticated sending tuned to reach the inbox.

deep.title: From your domain to the inbox, in seconds
deep.body: Verify your domain once and every email goes out signed and authenticated. Messages leave our servers immediately and typically reach recipients within a few seconds, anywhere in the world.
points: Your own verified domain with DKIM, SPF and DMARC
Six transactional templates, each editable as HTML
Schedule one-time, weekly or once-a-year campaigns
Daily volume scales with your plan

seo.title: Real-time team collaboration — Torta CRM
seo.description: See who's online, follow teammates' live cursors and watch shared edits across every page of your CRM. Cursor chat, presence and jump-to-teammate, built in.

hero.title: Your team, live on the same page
hero.lead: Live presence, cursors and shared editing across your whole CRM. See who's online and where, watch a teammate's cursor move with their name on it, and drop a message right on your pointer — on every project, product and org page.

stats.label: Presence and cursors on every project, product and org screen
See each teammate's pointer, labelled with their name
Watch edits land in a field as they're typed
A single WebSocket per session powers all of it

cards.title: Live presence
cards.desc: An avatar stack in the header and online dots show who's here, in real time.

cards.title: Live cursors
cards.desc: Every teammate's cursor moves live, labelled with their name and pixel-accurate across screens.

cards.title: Cursor chat
cards.desc: Press Ctrl+M to pin a quick message to your cursor — a word in the moment, no thread.

cards.title: Shared editing
cards.desc: Watch a teammate type into an email or product field, mirrored keystroke by keystroke.

cards.title: Jump to a teammate
cards.desc: Open the presence menu and click anyone to land exactly where they're working.

cards.title: Built to scale
cards.desc: One authenticated WebSocket per session, fanned out across instances with Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY.

deep.title: Your CRM, with everyone in the room
deep.body: Open any page and you can see who else is on it, where their cursor is and what they're editing — the moment it happens. No refresh, no plugin, on every screen from a single project to the whole organization.
points: Live presence, cursors and cursor-chat on every project, product and org page
Shared live editing in the email composer and product overview
Element-locked cursors stay pixel-accurate even on different monitors
One authenticated WebSocket, scaled across instances via Postgres LISTEN/NOTIFY

seo.title: Product catalog, inventory & warehouses — Torta CRM
seo.description: A deep catalog for physical goods: nested variations with inherited pricing, per-SKU cost and barcodes, multi-warehouse stock, batch tracking with expiry, promo codes, scheduled discounts and quantity tier pricing.

hero.title: A catalog built for real physical inventory
hero.lead: Sell physical products with deep, flexible configuration — nested variations, per-SKU pricing, cost and barcodes — then run stock across warehouses with batch tracking, promo codes, scheduled discounts and quantity tier pricing.

stats.label: Nested variations — price once or override per SKU
Stock, batches and transfers across locations
Expiry-first depletion with per-batch cost
Promo codes, scheduled discounts and tier pricing

cards.title: Flexible variations
cards.desc: Nest variations up to five levels deep — the leaf is the SKU. Price a whole variation once, or override it per item.

cards.title: Per-SKU details
cards.desc: An SKU code, auto-generated EAN-13 barcode, cost price, weight and dimensions on every sellable unit.

cards.title: Multi-warehouse stock
cards.desc: Track quantity per warehouse, transfer between them, and offer in-store pickup with delivery ETAs.

cards.title: Batch tracking
cards.desc: Receive stock in batches with production and expiry dates; depletion is expiry-first (FEFO) with per-batch cost for true COGS.

cards.title: Promo codes & discounts
cards.desc: Percentage or fixed promo codes with caps and limits, plus scheduled sales on a product, a variation or a single SKU.

cards.title: Tier pricing
cards.desc: Quantity-break pricing per SKU for wholesale — the right unit price kicks in automatically at checkout.

deep.title: Stock you can actually trust
deep.body: Receive, adjust and transfer stock from a dedicated Inventory view grouped by warehouse. Every movement is logged with a reason, batches deplete by expiry, and customers on a restock waitlist are emailed the moment an item is back.
points: Bulk-receive stock into batches with production, expiry and cost
Adjust with reason codes — delivery, return, recount, damage — fully logged
Transfer stock between warehouses in one atomic move
Low-stock and out-of-stock filters with live counters and margins

seo.title: Booking & appointment scheduling — Torta CRM
seo.description: Take appointments for your services: configurable duration, price and group capacity, staff with their own working hours, a drag-and-drop week calendar, and a public availability API to book from anywhere.

hero.title: Appointments, services and staff in one calendar
hero.lead: Let customers book your services online. Set each service's duration, price and group capacity, give staff their own schedules, and run it all on a drag-and-drop week calendar — or take bookings straight through the API.

stats.label: Set any service duration; group capacity for classes
Each staff member has their own weekly schedule
A real slots engine with seats-left for group bookings
Create bookings and read availability from the SDK

cards.title: Services
cards.desc: Each service sets its own duration, price and group capacity, and where it happens — at your shop, the customer's place, or either.

cards.title: Staff & schedules
cards.desc: Assign staff to services and give each one their own weekly working hours, including split shifts.

cards.title: Week calendar
cards.desc: A Google-Calendar-style week view. Drag a booking to reschedule — capacity is checked before the drop lands.

cards.title: Customers & statuses
cards.desc: Every booking carries the customer's name, phone and notes, and moves through pending, confirmed, completed, cancelled or no-show.

cards.title: Group capacity
cards.desc: Set a capacity above one and several customers can share the same slot — perfect for classes and group sessions.

cards.title: Public booking API
cards.desc: Read live availability and create bookings from your own site or app through the External API and the torta-js SDK.

deep.title: From an open slot to a confirmed appointment
deep.body: The availability engine walks each staff member's working hours, offers only slots where the full service fits and capacity is free, and confirms (or holds) the booking the moment it's made. Reschedule by dragging on the calendar — the duration moves with it.
points: Slot interval, lead time, max-advance and cancellation window are yours to set
Auto-confirm bookings or hold them as pending for review
Group capacity tracked per slot, with seats-left shown to customers
Drag-and-drop reschedule, with the calendar updating live for your team

seo.title: Customer chat — all messengers in one inbox — Torta CRM
seo.description: Talk to customers on Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Viber, X, Discord, email and a website widget — every conversation in one real-time inbox, with replies routed back to the channel they came from.

hero.title: Every customer message, in one inbox
hero.lead: Connect Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Viber, X, Discord, email and a website chat widget — and answer them all from a single real-time inbox. Reply once; it goes back out on the channel the customer used.

stats.label: Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Viber, X, Discord, email, web
Every channel threads into a single conversation list
New messages arrive live over a WebSocket — no refresh
Replies route back to the customer's original channel

cards.title: Nine channels
cards.desc: Website widget, Telegram, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Viber, X DMs, Discord and email — all wired in.

cards.title: Unified inbox
cards.desc: Messages from every channel land in one threaded list, with unread badges and last-message previews.

cards.title: Real-time
cards.desc: A WebSocket pushes new and edited messages the moment they arrive — your whole team sees them update.

cards.title: Privacy-safe threading
cards.desc: Customers appear under a stable anonymous ID, one conversation per person per channel.

cards.title: Email that threads
cards.desc: Email replies keep proper headers so they collapse into the same thread in Gmail and Outlook.

cards.title: Quick setup
cards.desc: Paste a bot token or connect a page; credentials are validated live, and the web widget needs nothing at all.

deep.title: Stop juggling a dozen apps
deep.body: Your customers message wherever they like — you answer from one screen. Each channel connects with its own simple setup, every conversation threads by customer, and replies are delivered back on the channel they came in on.
points: Connect a channel with a token or page link — validated the moment you save
Reply from the CRM; it's delivered on the originating channel
Email reuses your verified sending domain and threads correctly
Live updates, plus a notification when a new message comes in

seo.title: Sell digital products & downloads — Torta CRM
seo.description: Sell digital downloads — e-books, audio, video, ZIPs, almost any file. Upload from the dashboard, optionally bundle into one ZIP, and deliver automatically by email and on the order page after purchase.

hero.title: Sell downloads, delivered automatically
hero.lead: Upload the files you sell — e-books, audio, video, design assets, almost any type — set a price, and Torta delivers them the moment an order is paid: by email, on the receipt, and on the customer's order page.

stats.label: PDFs, audio, video, archives — up to 4 GB each
Bundle everything into a single download, or keep files separate
Links sent by email and shown on the order page after payment
Digital products never run out and skip the shipping step

cards.title: Upload & sell
cards.desc: Drag in the files you sell — almost any type, up to 4 GB each — and set a single price.

cards.title: One-ZIP delivery
cards.desc: Optionally bundle every file into one .zip the customer downloads in a single click.

cards.title: Automatic delivery
cards.desc: When the order is paid, download links go out by email, on the receipt PDF, and on the order page.

cards.title: Rich previews
cards.desc: Show off the product with a gallery of photos, video or 3D before the buyer commits.

cards.title: Frictionless checkout
cards.desc: Digital products skip the variation, stock and shipping steps — buyers go straight to download.

cards.title: Re-download anytime
cards.desc: Customers grab their files again from My Orders whenever they need them.

deep.title: Paid, then delivered — hands-free
deep.body: The moment a digital order is paid it's marked delivered — there's nothing to ship. The customer gets their download links three ways and can always come back for them. You just upload the files and set a price.
points: Files upload straight from the browser to fast object storage
Bundle into one ZIP (up to 200 MB) or deliver each file separately
Links delivered by email, on the receipt PDF and on the order page
Buyers re-download from My Orders at any time

seo.title: Ecommerce analytics & profit reporting — Torta CRM
seo.description: Real-time ecommerce analytics: revenue trends, sales-funnel conversion, gross margin by SKU, customer cohorts and lifetime value, returns and inventory health — across one store or your whole organization. No spreadsheets.

hero.title: Know exactly what's working
hero.lead: Revenue, conversion, profit margin down to the SKU, customer cohorts and lifetime value, returns, traffic and more — over twenty built-in reports, updated in real time, for one store or your whole organization. No setup, no spreadsheets.

stats.label: From revenue to cohorts to margin — built in
Real gross profit, using cost at the time of sale
New orders show up within seconds
Roll every store into one view, FX-converted

cards.title: Revenue & funnel
cards.desc: Revenue over time with period comparison, and a true unique-visitor funnel from view to cart to paid.

cards.title: Profit margin by SKU
cards.desc: Gross profit and margin per product, variation and SKU — using the cost captured at the moment of sale.

cards.title: Cohorts & lifetime value
cards.desc: Monthly retention cohorts, new-vs-returning, top customers and what they're worth over time.

cards.title: Returns & operations
cards.desc: Return rates and reasons, processing times, and fulfilment speed from order to delivery.

cards.title: Traffic & search
cards.desc: Sources, UTM campaigns, devices and countries — plus the searches that came back empty.

cards.title: Inventory & goals
cards.desc: Stock health at a glance and live progress against the targets you set.

deep.title: The reports a store actually needs
deep.body: Every metric is computed in your store's own timezone, cached for speed and refreshed in real time as orders land. Pick any date range, drill into a single day's orders, compare two periods, or export the numbers to CSV.
points: Every report respects your store's local day and timezone
Custom date ranges and period-over-period comparison everywhere
Drill from a chart straight into the underlying orders
Export any report to CSV for your own analysis

seo.title: Export orders to 1C, Kompra, QuickBooks & Xero — Torta CRM
seo.description: Export your store's orders and bookings to 25 accounting systems — 1C, Kompra (ЭСФ), QuickBooks, Xero, DATEV and more. The right format and encoding, VAT split out, on demand or auto-delivered to your accountant.

hero.title: Your sales, ready for your accountant
hero.lead: Export every order and booking to the accounting system you already use — 1C, Kompra, QuickBooks, Xero, DATEV and twenty more — in exactly the format it expects. Download on demand, or have it emailed to your accountant on a schedule.

stats.label: 1C, Kompra, QuickBooks, Xero, DATEV and 20 more
CSV or IIF, correct encoding, localized per system
Net, tax and gross split for the local rate
Daily, weekly or monthly to your accountant

cards.title: 1C & Kompra
cards.desc: Cyrillic-safe files for 1C 8.3, and bulk ЭСФ upload to Kompra with Kazakhstan's 12% VAT split out.

cards.title: QuickBooks, Xero & DATEV
cards.desc: IIF for QuickBooks, asterisked CSV for Xero, a Buchungsstapel for DATEV — each in its own native format.

cards.title: Built for your country
cards.desc: 25 systems across the CIS, Europe, Latin America and Asia, each matched to the local standard and tax rate.

cards.title: On a schedule
cards.desc: Send yesterday's, last week's or last month's sales automatically, at the hour you pick.

cards.title: Straight to your accountant
cards.desc: Scheduled exports arrive by email with a secure download link — always the latest file, no attachment.

cards.title: Numbers that reconcile
cards.desc: Paid orders only by default, returns subtracted, bookings included — the file matches your revenue.

deep.title: Pick a system, pick a period — done
deep.body: Choose your accounting software and a date range, and Torta builds the file in exactly the format it expects — the right delimiter, decimal separator, encoding and VAT treatment. Preview the first rows, download it, or set it to email your accountant on repeat.
points: Eight period presets plus any custom range, in your store's timezone
Net / VAT / gross split for the local tax rate
Orders and service bookings merged into one file
The preview matches the download, row for row

seo.title: Point of sale — sell in-store and online from one inventory — Torta CRM
seo.description: A built-in point of sale: ring up counter sales with a barcode scanner (no drivers), and every sale draws down the same stock your website sells from. One catalog, one inventory, one set of analytics.

hero.title: Sell at the counter and online, from one inventory
hero.lead: Ring up in-store sales with a barcode scanner — no drivers, no extra hardware — and every sale draws down the same stock, batches and analytics your website uses. Online and in-store, finally on one system.

stats.label: In-store and online sales share the same stock
Any keyboard-wedge barcode scanner — no drivers
Sells the earliest-expiry batch first, tracks cost
Counter and web sales in the same analytics

cards.title: Barcode checkout
cards.desc: Scan to add — the reader just types the code. Or browse the catalog by category and tap.

cards.title: Fast register
cards.desc: Build the ticket, take cash, card or other, add a walk-in customer — done in seconds.

cards.title: Shared stock
cards.desc: Every counter sale deducts from the same inventory your storefront sells from — no double-selling.

cards.title: Batches & cost
cards.desc: Picks the earliest-expiry batch by default and records its cost, so margin and FEFO stay correct.

cards.title: Per warehouse
cards.desc: Sell from the right location's stock, with pickup and delivery handled the same way as online.

cards.title: Live everywhere
cards.desc: A counter sale appears in Orders and Analytics in real time, exactly like a web order.

deep.title: One catalog. One stock. Online and in-store.
deep.body: There's no separate POS database. A sale at the register and a sale on your website land in the same orders table, deduct from the same batches, and feed the same reports — so your numbers are never split across two systems.
points: Hardware scanners work out of the box — they act as a keyboard
Stock, batches and cost stay in lockstep across both channels
Returns and refunds flow back through the same restock path
Walk-in or named customer, paid by cash, card or other

seo.title: Manage multiple online stores from one dashboard — Torta CRM
seo.description: Run several online stores from one account: separate catalogs, currencies and teams, with combined analytics across every store (currency-normalized) and an optional shared customer base.

hero.title: Run all your stores from one place
hero.lead: Open as many stores as you need under one account — each with its own catalog, currency, domain and team — then see them combined in one dashboard, with revenue rolled up across stores in a single currency.

stats.label: As many stores as you need, each fully isolated
Combined revenue and margin, FX-normalized
Optionally recognize a buyer across your stores
Each store with its own staff and roles

cards.title: Many stores, one login
cards.desc: Group stores into organizations and switch between them in a click — no separate accounts.

cards.title: Cross-store analytics
cards.desc: Combined revenue, orders and margin across every store, normalized into one currency.

cards.title: A store leaderboard
cards.desc: See which store earns the most and which has the best margin, side by side.

cards.title: Shared customers
cards.desc: Optionally recognize a customer who bought at one store when they visit another.

cards.title: Roles per store
cards.desc: Give each teammate access to just the stores and pages they need.

cards.title: Independent by design
cards.desc: Separate catalog, currency, domain and email per store — fully isolated data.

deep.title: From one shop to a whole group
deep.body: Every store is its own isolated workspace — its own products, orders, currency and team — but they roll up into organization-level analytics and an optional shared customer base, so a multi-brand operator manages everything from one screen.

Organization analytics sum revenue across stores, FX-converted
